task: SD-35 backlog assessment - number audit of forward-plan.json / ordered-plan.json / power-table-cost.json
headline_finding: forward-plan.json's own arithmetic reproduces exactly from its own data, and its priced-to-DONE and priced-to-V tiers are still live-accurate. But its single biggest number -- the 45.7% / 13,383-unit UNPRICED tier -- is severely stale: a corpus-wide oracle-harness widening (git log 'wave-9' through 'wave-22 shared regeneration' commits, plus AT-34-E3-005 'bucket-v-widen') has moved 6,572 of those units out of bucket V and 342 out of bucket M straight to DONE since forward-plan.json was last regenerated, dropping live unpriced units to 6,469 (28.9% of a now-smaller 22,369-unit remaining population), not 13,383 (45.7% of 29,283).
